source_policy: numeric research evidence only; source and candidate artwork remain outside Git

source_redundancy.outer_family: present in the compound white path and large black region
source_redundancy.inner_family: present in the compound white path and multiple separate black regions over disjoint arc intervals
source_redundancy.interpretation: the circular family is repeated source structure, not a fit to one isolated boundary

secondary_upper_band.classification: source-supported circular constant-width family within the current first-party export
secondary_upper_band.note: The normalized reconstruction retains the earlier intersection-compatible center/radii rather than replacing them with a raw-error optimum. The free and fixed-width fits are evidence for the family and nominal width, not automatic rewrite coordinates.

long_upper_band_width_cross_check.interpretation: independent support for 5.67 as the shared nominal ribbon width with small export drift

path9_end.rule: outer-edge intersection with upper-secondary-outer circle, projected radially to the path9 centerline

path5_start.reason: available intersection normalization has weaker source-vertex support and no visible structural benefit

path7_start.reason: the exact-intersection variant materially worsens localized source fit; the cardinal variant also slightly worsens it

validation_1600_cairosvg.assessment: endpoint normalization is visually negligible and slightly improves the raw comparison; structural evidence is the acceptance reason

rejected_path7_exact_intersection_varian.assessment: rejected; a mathematically convenient intersection is not supported as the authored hidden cap

next_step: Limit further Morat changes to connector/cap constraints that can be justified from source topology; the principal circle families, secondary upper band, lower-left cutout, and red regions are now sufficiently supported for the research model.
